release_slices.name: POS MapLibre tile routing hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Make the POS terminal setup and onboarding maps load real map tiles instead of a blank gray panel on the POS production host.
release_slices.purpose: Route POS MapLibre style and tile requests to OpenFreeMap by default when the POS app surface has no explicit tile base, while preserving the existing local /openfreemap proxy behavior for non-POS surfaces.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Updates the shared MapLibre helper so VITE_APP_SURFACE=pos uses the external OpenFreeMap style URL unless VITE_TILE_BASE is configured, avoids rewriting OpenFreeMap tile URLs back to the POS host, adds regression tests proving POS and non-POS routing behavior, aligns the POS handler transport test mock and accepted cashier/setup tests with the PR25 exports, fixes the POS terminal workspace lint violation, and documents the POS compliance impact.
included_features: POS map style fallback to OpenFreeMap when no POS tile proxy is configured
Non-POS surfaces keep same-origin /openfreemap proxy behavior
Regression tests for POS and non-POS MapLibre routing
POS handler transport test mock alignment for the PR25 cashier/setup use-case exports
Positive backend tests for the accepted POS setup cashier and cashier login use cases
Frontend lint-safe POS tab reset scheduling
excluded_features: PR #25 POS cashier/setup UI changes already represented by the previous hotfix
release_slices.owner_attribution: BabyBaBab owner-authorized POS map hotfix request
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: This hotfix changes shared map resource routing for the POS app surface; a mistake could keep POS onboarding/settings maps blank or accidentally alter non-POS tile proxy behavior.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: POS terminal onboarding primary store location map rendering
POS Settings Storefront Locations map rendering
IMS and Storefront map views that rely on the same local /openfreemap proxy helper
